column1: # Abstract endings. A row realizes one ending for one predicate class; G owns the phonology.
#   id      ending id (eomi:<id> in --why). Rows with the same id differ by pos.
#   slot    hon | tense | modal | final | conn | adn | nom | quote
#   family  final: the ending family (plain, ne, ji, ...); conn: the relations it serves (rel=...);
#           adn: nonpast | past | fut | retro; nom: m | gi; quote: the mood it quotes
#   mood    decl | q | imp | prop | excl | - (any)
#   level   haera | hae | haeyo | hapsyo | hao | hage | - (any)
#   pos     V verb | A adjective | X 있다/없다 | C copula 이다 | N 아니다 | P after 었/겠 | * any.
#           Lookup falls back P → X → *, X → *, N → C → A → *, C → A → *, V → *, A → *.
#   form    notation: 어… = harmonic vowel (아/어/여); (으)… = 으 after a consonant; A/B = after a
#           consonant / after a vowel or ㄹ; a leading jamo (ㄴ ㄹ ㅁ ㅂ) becomes the final of the stem;
#   flags   hon-incl: the form already holds -시- (no second 시); words: the form spans words
